source.citation: George Glessner, photograph of an Illinois Central train at the foot of 18th Street, c. 1888, looking east from the end of the street. Reproduced in "The early history of Prairie Avenue", Glessner House blog, June 2020.
what_it_does_not_supply: Anything as of 1904 on its own authority
what_it_supplies: The street's end against the right-of-way at 18th Street: curb, then cinder ground and tracks
That nothing like a beach or a public walk lay between the tracks and the water at 18th Street c. 1888
